verdict.rationale: FreshBooks tracks bills and vendors: Bill Pay manages bills, tracks due dates and shows payment status from created to paid, and the API exposes Bills and Bill Vendors (beta). It is also double-entry, and accountants can run reports. However, nothing in the evidence shows an AP aging report or as-of-date vendor balances, and the listed report types (Invoice Details, Manual Journal Entry, Payments Collected) do not include AP aging. Missing for 10: a documented AP aging report, vendor balance reporting, point-in-time (as-of date) reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
